visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Subtractive Pairs Are Added
visualizerParams.problemDescription: IV is 4, but the program prints 6, and MCMXCIV prints 2216 instead of 1994.

solution.explanation: When a smaller symbol stands in front of a bigger one, it is subtracted: IV is 5 - 1. Adding every symbol turns IV into 1 + 5 = 6.
